C001C.title: Right Rear Inlet Control
C001C.description: Fault on right rear ABS inlet (apply) valve.

C001E.title: Right Rear Hydraulic Release Too Long

C0020.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit
C0020.description: The ABS control module detects an electrical fault in the pump motor circuit. Without a working pump, the system cannot build hydraulic pressure for ABS or stability control interventions and disables those functions.

causes.label: Pump motor seized after long inactivity
Pump motor relay welded or open

C0021.title: Brake Booster Performance
C0021.description: C0021 means the brake booster does not deliver the assist the brake control module expects, for example because vacuum or pressure builds up too slowly or an electromechanical booster does not reach its target. With weak assist the driver needs more pedal force. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Vacuum leak at hose, check valve or booster diaphragm
Weak vacuum pump or low engine vacuum

C0022.title: Brake Booster Solenoid
C0022.description: C0022 concerns the solenoid valve on the brake booster that lets the brake control module build up assist without pedal input, for example for emergency brake assist; the related circuit codes are C0566 to C0569. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

C0023.title: Stop Lamp Control
C0023.description: C0023 concerns the circuit through which the brake control module switches the stop lamps itself, which it does when it brakes automatically (for example adaptive cruise control or emergency braking) so that following traffic is warned. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Open or shorted stop lamp control wiring
Faulty stop lamp relay or driver

symptoms: Stop lamps not lit during automatic braking
Driver-assistance braking functions may be disabled

C0024.title: Brake Pedal Feedback Pressure Solenoid Circuit
C0024.description: Fault on brake pedal feedback pressure solenoid — used in brake-by-wire systems to provide pedal feel.

C0025.title: Brake Pedal Feedback Pressure Sensor Circuit
C0025.description: C0025 concerns the sensor that measures the feedback pressure acting on the brake pedal in brake-by-wire or pedal-simulator systems; together with the feedback pressure solenoid (C0024) it gives the driver a natural pedal feel while braking is done electronically. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

C0030.title: Left Front Tone Wheel
C0030.description: C0030 concerns the tone wheel (encoder ring) at the left front wheel, whose teeth or magnetic poles the wheel speed sensor reads. A cracked, dirty or missing segment produces a signal pattern the ABS module recognises as faulty. Without a plausible wheel speed the module switches off ABS and stability control for the rest of the drive. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Metal debris or rust on the encoder
Wrong hub or bearing with different encoder fitted

symptoms: ABS, ESC or brake warning light on
Stability and traction control may be switched off

C0031.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor
C0031.description: C0031 concerns the left front wheel speed sensor itself. SAE groups the wheel speed codes per wheel as tone wheel, sensor and sensor supply. Without a plausible wheel speed the module switches off ABS and stability control for the rest of the drive. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Excessive air gap from a worn bearing

symptoms: ABS, ESC or brake warning light on
Stability and traction control may be switched off

C0032.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C0032.description: C0032 concerns the supply voltage the ABS module provides to the active left front wheel speed sensor. Without a plausible wheel speed the module switches off ABS and stability control for the rest of the drive. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Supply wire shorted to ground or open

symptoms: ABS, ESC or brake warning light on
Stability and traction control may be switched off

C0033.title: Right Front Tone Wheel
C0033.description: C0033 concerns the tone wheel (encoder ring) at the right front wheel, whose teeth or magnetic poles the wheel speed sensor reads. A cracked, dirty or missing segment produces a signal pattern the ABS module recognises as faulty. Without a plausible wheel speed the module switches off ABS and stability control for the rest of the drive. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Metal debris or rust on the encoder
Wrong hub or bearing with different encoder fitted

symptoms: ABS, ESC or brake warning light on
Stability and traction control may be switched off

C0034.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor
C0034.description: C0034 concerns the right front wheel speed sensor itself. SAE groups the wheel speed codes per wheel as tone wheel, sensor and sensor supply. Without a plausible wheel speed the module switches off ABS and stability control for the rest of the drive. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Excessive air gap from a worn bearing

symptoms: ABS, ESC or brake warning light on
Stability and traction control may be switched off

C0035.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0035.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the left front wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.label: Tone ring (reluctor) damaged or contaminated with debris
Wiring break or chafe at wheel arch
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0036.title: Left Rear Tone Wheel
C0036.description: C0036 concerns the tone wheel (encoder ring) at the left rear wheel, whose teeth or magnetic poles the wheel speed sensor reads. A cracked, dirty or missing segment produces a signal pattern the ABS module recognises as faulty. Without a plausible wheel speed the module switches off ABS and stability control for the rest of the drive. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Metal debris or rust on the encoder
Wrong hub or bearing with different encoder fitted

symptoms: ABS, ESC or brake warning light on
Stability and traction control may be switched off

C0037.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor
C0037.description: Generic fault on left rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0038.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C0038.description: Fault on left rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0039.title: Right Rear Tone Wheel
C0039.description: Fault detected on right rear tone wheel (pulse ring).

C003A.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor
C003A.description: Generic fault on right rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003B.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C003B.description: Fault on right rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003C.title: Rear Tone Wheel
C003C.description: Fault on shared rear tone wheel (single rear sensor on solid axle).

C003D.title: Rear Wheel Speed Sensor
C003D.description: Generic fault on shared rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003E.title: Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C003E.description: Fault on rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003F.title: Wheel Speed Sensors Rotation Direction Correlation
C003F.description: Wheel speed sensors disagree on rotation direction — typically detected when reversing. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0040.title: Brake Pedal Switch A
C0040.description: C0040 concerns brake pedal switch A. Many cars use two switches with opposite logic so the modules can cross-check whether the pedal is pressed; the signal controls stop lamps, cruise control cancel and brake-shift interlock. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.
symptoms: Stop lamps stay on or off

C0041.title: Brake Pedal Switch B
C0041.description: C0041 concerns brake pedal switch B. Many cars use two switches with opposite logic so the modules can cross-check whether the pedal is pressed; the signal controls stop lamps, cruise control cancel and brake-shift interlock. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.
symptoms: Stop lamps stay on or off

C0042.title: Brake Pedal Position Sensor Circuit A
C0042.description: C0042 concerns circuit A of the brake pedal position sensor, which measures how far the pedal is pressed; brake-by-wire systems, regenerative braking and electromechanical boosters rely on it to calculate the braking request. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.
symptoms: Regenerative braking or brake assist reduced

C0043.title: Brake Pedal Position Sensor Circuit B
C0043.description: C0043 concerns circuit B of the brake pedal position sensor, which measures how far the pedal is pressed; brake-by-wire systems, regenerative braking and electromechanical boosters rely on it to calculate the braking request. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.
symptoms: Regenerative braking or brake assist reduced

C0044.title: Brake Pressure Sensor A
C0044.description: C0044 concerns brake pressure sensor A, which measures hydraulic pressure (usually in the master cylinder circuit) so the ESC module can recognise the driver's braking request and dose active brake interventions. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Pressure sensor failed (often integrated in the ESC unit)

symptoms: ABS, ESC or brake warning light on
Stability and traction control may be switched off

C0045.title: Brake Pressure Sensor B
C0045.description: C0045 concerns brake pressure sensor B, which measures hydraulic pressure (usually in the master cylinder circuit) so the ESC module can recognise the driver's braking request and dose active brake interventions. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Pressure sensor failed (often integrated in the ESC unit)

symptoms: ABS, ESC or brake warning light on
Stability and traction control may be switched off

C0046.title: Brake Pressure Sensor A/B
C0046.description: C0046 means brake pressure sensors A and B disagree beyond the allowed tolerance. Systems with two pressure sensors compare them to detect a drifting sensor. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Pressure sensor failed (often integrated in the ESC unit)

symptoms: ABS, ESC or brake warning light on
Stability and traction control may be switched off

C0047.title: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor
C0047.description: Generic fault on brake booster pressure sensor. This sensor reports the pressure the booster works with, vacuum in a conventional vacuum booster, and the brake control module uses it to judge how much assist is available, to run an electric vacuum pump where fitted, and to support functions such as hydraulic brake assist. If power assist is lost, the brakes still work through the master cylinder, but a much higher pedal force is needed.
symptoms: Brake system warning lamp or message
Firmer brake pedal, longer pedal travel or higher pedal force
Driver-assistance functions such as automatic emergency braking or adaptive cruise control may be disabled

C0048.title: Brake Booster Travel Sensor
C0048.description: Generic fault on brake booster travel/position sensor. The travel sensor measures how far the booster input rod, and with it the brake pedal, has moved; on an electromechanical booster such as Bosch's iBooster this signal is what the control unit turns into a motor command, so a faulty signal reduces or removes power assist. If power assist is lost, the brakes still work through the master cylinder, but a much higher pedal force is needed.
symptoms: Brake system warning lamp or message
Firmer brake pedal, longer pedal travel or higher pedal force
Driver-assistance functions such as automatic emergency braking or adaptive cruise control may be disabled

C0049.title: Brake Fluid Level
C0049.description: Brake fluid level low — typically detected by reservoir float switch.

causes.label: Low brake fluid (leak or pad wear)

C004A.title: Brake Lining Wear Sensor
C004A.description: Brake lining wear sensor reports thin pads.

C004B.title: Brake Fluid Level Sensor/Switch Circuit/Open
C004B.description: Open circuit on brake fluid level sensor or switch.

causes.label: Pin pushed back out of connector body
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor

C004C.title: Brake Booster Motor A Position Sensor Exceeded Learning Limit
C004C.description: Brake booster motor A position sensor learned offset exceeded the allowed range. The motor position sensor reports the rotor angle of the booster's electric motor; after replacement or calibration the module learns its reference position, and if that learned value lies outside the permitted window it no longer trusts the signal and limits assist. A relearn with a scan tool is usually part of the repair. If power assist is lost, the brakes still work through the master cylinder, but a much higher pedal force is needed.
symptoms: Brake system warning lamp or message
Firmer brake pedal, longer pedal travel or higher pedal force
Driver-assistance functions such as automatic emergency braking or adaptive cruise control may be disabled

C004D.title: Brake System Pressure Slow Response
C004D.description: Brake system pressure response slower than expected.

C004E.title: Brake System Pressure Control Valve Actuator Stuck
C004E.description: Brake system pressure control valve actuator stuck mechanically.

C004F.title: ABS Control Module Over Temperature
C004F.description: ABS control module exceeded its safe operating temperature.

causes.label: Thermal overload from extended ABS use

C0050.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0050.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.label: Wiring break or chafe under chassis
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0051.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor
C0051.description: C0051 concerns the steering wheel position (angle) sensor, which tells stability control and steering-related systems where the driver is steering; C0052 to C0055 cover its individual signals. Without a trusted steering angle ESC is switched off; after alignment work or battery disconnection the sensor often only needs calibrating. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Sensor not calibrated after alignment or battery disconnection
Sensor or clock spring assembly failed

symptoms: Stability control and lane-keeping functions disabled

C0052.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Signal A
C0052.description: C0052 concerns signal A of the steering wheel position (angle) sensor. The sensor delivers several redundant signals that the module checks against each other; C0051 is the general sensor code. Without a trusted steering angle ESC is switched off; after alignment work or battery disconnection the sensor often only needs calibrating. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Sensor not calibrated after alignment or battery disconnection
Sensor or clock spring assembly failed

symptoms: Stability control and lane-keeping functions disabled

C0053.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Signal B
C0053.description: C0053 concerns signal B of the steering wheel position (angle) sensor. The sensor delivers several redundant signals that the module checks against each other; C0051 is the general sensor code. Without a trusted steering angle ESC is switched off; after alignment work or battery disconnection the sensor often only needs calibrating. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Sensor not calibrated after alignment or battery disconnection
Sensor or clock spring assembly failed

symptoms: Stability control and lane-keeping functions disabled

C0054.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Signal C
C0054.description: C0054 concerns signal C of the steering wheel position (angle) sensor. The sensor delivers several redundant signals that the module checks against each other; C0051 is the general sensor code. Without a trusted steering angle ESC is switched off; after alignment work or battery disconnection the sensor often only needs calibrating. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Sensor not calibrated after alignment or battery disconnection
Sensor or clock spring assembly failed

symptoms: Stability control and lane-keeping functions disabled

C0055.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Signal D
C0055.description: C0055 concerns signal D of the steering wheel position (angle) sensor. Without a trusted steering angle ESC is switched off; after alignment work or battery disconnection the sensor often only needs calibrating. causes.label: Sensor not calibrated after alignment or battery disconnection
Sensor or clock spring assembly failed

symptoms: Stability control and lane-keeping functions disabled

C0056.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0056.description: Intermittent open or short on the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.label: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0060.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit
C0060.description: The ABS control module detects a fault in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. ABS and stability control are deactivated.

C0061.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor
C0061.description: C0061 concerns the sensor for sideways acceleration. On current vehicles it is usually part of an inertial sensor cluster inside the airbag or ESC module (compare C0069 and C006A). Without a plausible value the stability control cannot judge the vehicle's motion and is switched off. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Sensor cluster loose or mounted at an angle

C0062.title: Longitudinal Acceleration Sensor
C0062.description: C0062 concerns the sensor for acceleration along the vehicle axis, used for example for hill hold and 4WD logic. On current vehicles it is usually part of an inertial sensor cluster inside the airbag or ESC module (compare C0069 and C006A). Without a plausible value the stability control cannot judge the vehicle's motion and is switched off. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Sensor cluster loose or mounted at an angle

C0063.title: Yaw Rate Sensor
C0063.description: C0063 concerns the sensor for rotation about the vertical axis, the key input for detecting skids. On current vehicles it is usually part of an inertial sensor cluster inside the airbag or ESC module (compare C0069 and C006A). Without a plausible value the stability control cannot judge the vehicle's motion and is switched off. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Sensor cluster loose or mounted at an angle

C0064.title: Roll Rate Sensor
C0064.description: C0064 concerns the sensor for rotation about the longitudinal axis, used for rollover mitigation. On current vehicles it is usually part of an inertial sensor cluster inside the airbag or ESC module (compare C0069 and C006A). Without a plausible value the stability control cannot judge the vehicle's motion and is switched off. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Sensor cluster loose or mounted at an angle

C0065.title: Vertical Acceleration Sensor
C0065.description: C0065 concerns the sensor for vertical acceleration, used by some suspension and stability functions. On current vehicles it is usually part of an inertial sensor cluster inside the airbag or ESC module (compare C0069 and C006A). Without a plausible value the stability control cannot judge the vehicle's motion and is switched off. The code is a general fault for this component; the module stores it when the signal or circuit fails a check that no more specific code covers.

causes.label: Sensor cluster loose or mounted at an angle

C0066.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0066.description: Intermittent open or short on the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.label: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0069.title: Yaw Rate/Longitude Sensors
C0069.description: Generic fault on yaw rate/longitudinal acceleration sensor cluster.

C006A.title: Multi-axis Acceleration Sensor
C006A.description: Generic fault on multi-axis acceleration sensor (combines lateral, longitudinal and vertical accelerations).

C006B.title: Stability System Active Too Long
C006B.description: Electronic stability control intervened for an excessive duration.

causes.label: Extended intervention from low traction or driver behavior

C006C.title: Stability System
C006C.description: Generic fault in electronic stability control system.

C0070.title: Vehicle Speed Sensor Circuit
C0070.description: The chassis controller detects a fault in the dedicated vehicle speed sensor circuit (when present in addition to wheel speed sensors).

C0072.title: Brake Temperature Too High
C0072.description: Brake temperature exceeded safe operating limit — risk of brake fade.

causes.label: Hard or prolonged braking, mountain descent

C0073.title: Delivered Driving Torque
C0073.description: Engine-delivered driving torque does not match TCS request.

C0074.title: Requested Driving Torque
C0074.description: Driving torque request from TCS rejected or out of range.

C0075.title: Brake Pedal Position Performance
C0075.description: Brake pedal position sensor reading implausible.

C0076.title: PWM for Traction Control
C0076.description: PWM communication signal for traction control faulty.

C0077.title: Low Tire Pressure
C0077.description: Tire pressure monitoring system detected low tire pressure.

C0078.title: Tire Diameter
C0078.description: Detected wheel speed implies tire diameter outside expected range — typically wrong tire size or mismatched tires.

C0079.title: Variable Effort Steering
C0079.description: Generic fault on variable effort steering (VES) system.

C0080.title: Wheel Speed Mismatch (Front Axle)
C0080.description: Front axle wheel speeds differ beyond the plausibility threshold over time. Often caused by mismatched tyre rolling circumference or a partially failing sensor.

causes.label: Mixed tyre sizes or worn tyre on one side

C0081.title: ABS Malfunction Indicator
C0081.description: Rear axle wheel speeds differ beyond the plausibility threshold. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0082.title: Brake System Malfunction Indicator
C0082.description: Brake system malfunction indicator circuit fault.

C0084.title: Traction Active Indicator
C0084.description: Traction control active indicator lamp circuit fault.

C0085.title: Traction Disable Indicator
C0085.description: Traction control disable indicator lamp circuit fault.

C0086.title: Vehicle Dynamics Indicator
C0086.description: Vehicle dynamics control indicator lamp circuit fault.

C008A.title: TCS Mode Control
C008A.description: Fault on TCS mode control input (offroad/sport mode etc.).

C0090.title: 4WD/AWD Power Transfer Unit Actuator
C0090.description: The brake pressure sensor in the master cylinder or hydraulic block reports an implausible signal or no signal. The fault disables ABS, stability control and brake assist.

C0091.title: 4WD/AWD Power Transfer Unit Position Sensor A
C0091.description: The brake pressure sensor signal is outside the plausibility band relative to pedal application. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0092.title: 4WD/AWD Power Transfer Unit Position Sensor B
C0092.description: Fault on 4WD/AWD power transfer unit (PTU) position sensor B.

C0094.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Temperature Sensor
C0094.description: Fault on rear differential unit temperature sensor.

C0095.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A
C0095.description: Fault on rear differential unit actuator A.

C0096.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Data
C0096.description: Rear differential actuator A data implausible or out of range.

C0097.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B
C0097.description: Fault on rear differential unit actuator B.

C0098.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Data
C0098.description: Rear differential actuator B data implausible or out of range.

C0099.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor A
C0099.description: The ABS control module fails its internal self-test (RAM, ROM or processor watchdog). ABS and stability control are disabled.

C009A.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor B
C009A.description: Fault on rear differential actuator A position sensor B.

C009B.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor C
C009B.description: Fault on rear differential actuator A position sensor C.

C009C.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor Correlation

C009E.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor B
C009E.description: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor B.

C009F.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor C
C009F.description: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor C.

C00A0.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor Correlation
C00A0.description: Position sensors on rear differential actuator B disagree.

C00A1.title: Driveline Control Module
C00A1.description: Generic fault on driveline control module.

C00A2.title: Driveline Control Module Power Transfer Unit Control Circuit Driver
